gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Apple now sells the Apple Watch Ultra 4 from $799 in the place of the Ultra 3 that ChatGPT showed as its card, rated for up to 50 hours of normal use against the Amazfit T-Rex 3 Pro's up to 25 days at $399.99. Garmin's current flagship is also the fēnix 9 (from $999.99) and the fēnix 9 Pro (from $1,099.99), not the fēnix 8 Pro that ChatGPT priced at $1,099.99.
standout_why: The only rival ChatGPT cited is mobileplustech.com (2026-11-01), which I opened. It names the Apple Watch Ultra 3, Fenix 8, Instinct 3, T-Rex 3, Galaxy Watch Ultra and G-Shock but gives no prices, no battery-day figures and no weights. It also says nothing about the Ultra 4 or the fēnix 9. The TechRadar T-Rex 3 Pro review returned only its headline ('half the price of an Apple Watch Ultra 3'), which still frames Ultra 3 as the current model. ChatGPT's own answer showed an Ultra 3 card and a 'Fēnix 8 Pro $1,099.99', and both models have been superseded.
decides: The value pick for most buyers stays the Amazfit T-Rex 3 Pro: $399.99 on Amazfit's US store, with sapphire glass, a titanium bezel and up to 25 days on the 48 mm. The premium iPhone choice should be the Ultra 4 (from $799, up to 50 h), not the Ultra 3. On rated battery the T-Rex 3 Pro lasts about 12 times as long for half the price. ChatGPT's high-end Garmin pick should be updated to the fēnix 9 / 9 Pro.
